Well, hello, Doctor. It's very nice of you to see me today. I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time. My wife thought it would be a good idea to come in, just to chat. 

You see, I've been noticing... well, I don't want to make a fuss, but the men I play dominoes with, they've been saying little things. Just passing comments, you know? But I can tell they're meant for me. And sometimes, even the fellow on the radio, he slips in these little messages. My wife, she says it's just talk, just regular chatter, and maybe I shouldn't pay it any mind. But... I know they're warning me to be careful. Does that make sense, Doctor? I'm just trying to be cautious, like they're telling me to. I hope that's alright to say.

Well, my mood? Oh, it's been just fine, Doctor. Really, I can't complain. I mean, everyone gets a little blue now and then, don't they? But I wouldn't say I've been depressed or anything like that. I try to keep a cheerful disposition, especially for my wife's sake. I don't want her worrying over me.

Oh, no, Doctor. No, nothing like that. My health is quite good, thankfully. I mean, at eighty-four, you expect a few creaks in the joints, but I haven't had any big medical problems or... what did you call it, neurological things? No, none of that. 

I make sure to eat right and take my daily walks, you know, just to keep everything ticking along. I haven't been to the hospital or had any major changes at all. I'm pretty healthy for my age, I think. That's a good thing, isn't it, Doctor? I hope I'm taking care of myself the right way.

Well, it's... it's nothing frightening, Doctor. I really don't want you to think I'm hearing anything awful or scary. It's actually quite pleasant, most of the time.

Oh, my thoughts broadcast out loud? Oh, no, no, nothing like that, Doctor. I wouldn't say people can read my mind or anything so... so strange as that. I'm just a regular fellow, you know? 

Well, I suppose... I mean, I did want to mention something, if it's alright. It's just a small thing, really. Sometimes, when I'm down playing dominoes with the men, or... or even just listening to the radio announcer in the afternoon... it seems like they slip in these little messages. Just little things, meant for me. 

My wife, bless her heart, she tells me it's just regular talk and I'm making something out of nothing. But... well, I just get the feeling they're warning me, you know? Just telling me to be careful. It's nothing bad, they're just looking out for me, I think. That's not too unusual, is it, Doctor? Just picking up on little warnings here and there? I hope I'm explaining it alright.
